potencia.elite: The coach at full power, with deep mode.

brief.detalle: Orders and numbers before the day starts.

plan.detalle: Your day laid out hour by hour, with what each hour is for.

entreno.detalle: Exercises, sets and loads based on the RPE you log.

dieta.detalle: Adjusted to your real weight and its trend, not to a table.

revision.detalle: Measures the week with your data and readjusts your system.

memoria.detalle: Remembers what it learns about you. Knows you better every week.

chat.detalle: Tell it and it does it: missions, schedule, rules, goals.

potencia.detalle: A frontier model in every brief, plan, review and conversation.

profundo.detalle: For what needs real thought: the coach takes its time and answers in more detail.

revisionFondo.detalle: Your week measured by the frontier model, thinking it through.

ludus.titulo: Request a place in a ludus (5-8)
ludus.detalle: A group of 5 to 8 Élite gladiators with your goal and their own scoreboard. Places are assigned by hand, depending on availability.

laurel.detalle: The golden laurel next to your name. Status, not points: it doesn't change any ranking.

pro.linea: Your oath is sealed. The coach can lead your day from tomorrow.
pro.contexto: Your oath is sealed. NIVL stays fully free; Pro adds the coach that leads it.

elite.linea: Your oath is sealed. Élite is the coach at full power.
elite.contexto: Your oath is sealed. NIVL stays fully free; Élite adds the coach at full power.
